t: You're looking at a bust of T. P. O'Connor, a sculpture by Francis William Doyle-Jones. It commemorates Thomas Power O'Connor, a British politician who lived from 1848 to 1929. Doyle-Jones was an English sculptor, mainly of portraits, and he is also known for the many war memorials he made for British towns and cities after the Boer War and the First World War. Here, his portrait work keeps O'Connor's likeness on public view.
